text:
Fantastic experience from initial meeting to final completion/inspection. The owner, Ralph, was extremely helpful explaining products and handling my MANY questions.

We met with Ralph prior to contract to discuss products and approach to full roof replacement. Ralph’s wealth of information and transparency was amazing and truly made us comfortable with our decision.

His crew showed up promptly every day and even dealt with rain during the process. Clean up was superb each day.

We’ve had a lot of contractors in and out of our house in the last 20 months. Ralph was very transparent, honest and easy to work with.

We highly recommend Apex Roofing!
Pierce was amazing! Very responsive and professional. Was able to diagnose the problem and fix it immediately. Would definitely recommend and use them again.

Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry did a great job replacing our semi-aging roof. Although our roof had not reached the end of its service life and had not been exhibiting any significant problems, I knew it was only a matter of time before a replacement would become necessary. Financial considerations and personal availability dictated that that time was sooner rather than later.
I met with both owners of the company, Ralph and Pierce Brehany. Both are friendly, honest, and easy to work with. And both agreed with my own assessment for a roof replacement. Ralph explained to me all that would be done during the replacement. And he took care of obtaining the town and the HOA permits, and once he had those in hand, we set up the schedule to begin the job.
His full crew showed up on Monday morning, right at the scheduled time and went right to work, working continuously through each day. The crew did a pretty good job of cleaning up much of the debris at the end of each workday. I was really surprised that everything was as neat and orderly as it was, considering the arduous work of removing of an entire roof. As an unexpected benefit, each day I received photos, showing the completed work to date. Ralph was always available and on call during that week, in case there were any problems or concerns or if I had any questions. The weather cooperated, and despite the extreme heat, the roof was completed on schedule. Clean-up of the job site following completion of the roof was thorough. The crew even went around our home with a metal detector, picking up the countless loose nails and screws. I was very surprised at how very few of them were missed following their final search/inspection!
It passed the town's final inspection without any difficulties.
I don't know very much about roofing, but based on my observations, I believe that the roofing crew did an excellent job of laying down the GAF Feltbuster synthetic underlayment over all the roof surfaces, as well as the GAF asphalt shingles and ridge caps. They certainly demonstrated their experience and expertise. I feel certain that the roof is secure and will be free of any problems in the future.
Following the job completion, Ralph provided me with the warranties that come with all the GAF products that were applied to our roof, which I was not initially aware of but am very pleased with. In my opinion, the various System Plus Limited Warranties justified the replacement of the roof and its total cost, and it certainly assured me of its future viability. At a minimum, the new roof has certainly increased the value and the marketability of our home, for which we are very happy.
Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry is an honest, competent, and professional experienced small business, and a pleasure to work with. I give it my highest recommendation if you need to replace or repair your roof.

Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry did an excellent job of replacing our shingles. The crew we had did a great job in cleaning up after the job was done. Our roof looks great. Ralph and his son Pierce communicated with us very well and was easy to work with on this job. The crew was great to work with us also.
Top notch roofing company.  We had a great experience.

I live in Hampton Hall in Bluffton and I had a need recently to get a quote for a new roof. Apex Roofing came highly recommended, so I requested a quote from them.  The owner, Ralph, was very quick to respond with a very competitive quote. We then followed up with a face to face (at my request) to go over some of the finer details. From start to finish I was very impressed with Ralph for his professionalism, attention to detail and candor. He made me feel very comfortable from the beginning. I awarded Apex with the job and Ralph remained very engaged in my project, calling me daily to follow up and forwarding me daily photographs of the progress. His work crew were great. Hard working, professional, timely, friendly, etc.  They portrayed a lot of the same characteristics that Ralph did so this is truly an organization that practices what they preach at all levels. I would have no qualms recommending Apex Roofing to anyone in need of their services.

Apex roofing just completed our new roof.  We cant say enough good things about our experience.  The crew worked tirelessly through some of the hottest weather of the season.  Ralph responded immediately to our every concern.  If we could give more than 5 stars we would.  Highly recommend!

Great experience with Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry. Had a slow roof leak on a metal roof that is 7 years old. Called several roofers that were recommended by neighbors. One of them was Apex, spoke with Ralph the owner and he had his son Pearce call, and he came by the next day. He assessed the situation and in under 15 minutes fixed the leak and then wouldn't let me pay him. The next day it rained cats & dogs all day and NO leaking. One of the other roofers came by a few days before and quoted me $3,000 to fix the leak. I would highly recommend Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry and will definitely use them in the future.

Apex replaced the roof on my house and changed the skylights with a much better product. They kept me updated on the progress and I could not have been more pleased with the results. A great company to do business with I would highly recommend them .

We highly recommend Apex Roofing.  Not only did Apex provide a beautiful roof, they also provided timely communication before, during, and after the job was completed.  Ralph explained the continuous improvement philosophy his company utilizes to assure the quality of their work.  This is something one might expect with a Fortune 500 company, yet Apex does the same.  The crew we had was courteous, hard working, efficient, and neat.  The 10 year workmanship warranty shows confidence in the work done.

Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry is the absolute BEST!! They are professional, prompt, personable, and have great communication skills! Trustworthy with every question answered, and great accountability!! All jobs are done very well and in a timely manner, backed by warranty; and if there is any issue, they respond and deal immediately!! Our family loves their company so much that we have used them for 3 roofs on 3 of our homes in the past year. Ralph, Pierce, and their crews are amazing!! Totally recommend!!! Thank you, Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry!!!!

Ralph and the Apex Roofing team are wonderful! I didn't think I could be impressed with a roofing company but Apex is impressive. Communication was great from start to finish. The roofing crew were timely, efficient, and kept the worksite neat and tidy. Our new roof looks so good! I would highly recommend Apex Roofing.
Local Family Biz with Ralph and Son, Pierce, delivered  best products and high level execution for our new roof installation. 2 days in n out. Not a trace of rubbish was left behind.

I contacted Ralph the week before Christmas on a recommendation from a friend as I needed an emergency roof inspection.  With the holidays coming up I wasn't sure how quickly Apex would be able to come and inspect our roof.  But Ralph told me they could look at it our roof that week.  Apex called me later that week to tell me they were on their way.  Showed up on time, inspected the roof as requested and provided photos and a written report the next day.  Very satisfied with my experience with Apex.

Wonderful people to work with!!!! We needed our roof replaced.  They were always easy to reach and answered all of our questions.  They showed up on time and had the job finished when they said they would.  I would recommend them to anyone needed roof work!

We highly recommend Apex. They responded immediately to a leak on an old roof. Ultimately we hired them to replace the entire roof, and I can’t say enough about their professionalism and quality of work! Hands down the best!

I am a retired professional career Realtor,  working in the housing industry for over thirty years.  I have had a good share of roofing issues working with clients and roofing companies.   Apex Roofing is exceptional, knowledgeable, timely and reliable operating with an extremely efficient crew.  Their quality of work is outstanding and I have no hesitation in recommending Apex Roofing.
The team at Apex is awesome from start to finish. Responsive and caring through the whole process! Highly recommend!
I have consulted with Ralph on several projects.  He is very professional and responsive.  I highly recommend these guys.  Honest assessments and pricing for roofing needs.

We unfortunately had a tree limb crash and make a gaping hole in our roof. Apex Roofing of the Low Country was recommended to us by a neighbor and they responded quickly and patched the hole in our roof to prevent any additional damage to our home.
After receiving our estimate for repair, we decided to have Apex Roofing of the Low Country replace our entire roof instead of just the damaged area. The work was scheduled and performed efficiently and quickly.
We were quite pleased with the workmanship and price. We would highly recommend Apex Roofing of the Low Country for any and all repairs to your roof.

Expected much more than I received from the roofers who did my inspection for hail damage.  Very disappointed in that they did not take one photograph of the hail damages sustained on my roof ... simply did a visual inspection and offered little support to me throughout the claims process.  Would not recommend hiring Apex to do roof inspections as they are not very thorough.

Professional. Friendly. Reasonable. I recommend Apex Roofing 100%. The owner, Ralph, is experienced, efficient, professional, competent,warm, and friendly. He answered all my questions with confidence and patience. It’s obvious he has an experienced team+equipment. The work began on time, finished on time, and the price was fair. Yes I did get 4 estimates.While the price from Apex was not the lowest it was in the expected price range.I felt confident with Apex.I respect the displayed organization of his business. His son,Pierce, has the same work ethic as his father. The crew worked together as a well oiled team. When neither Brehany was on site, one crew leader was assigned. Phone calls, emails, and texts were answered promptly. I rate this company at a top notched 100%.
No exceptions. No buts…the whole outfit 100%
This is a great company! I can’t say enough about Ralph and Pierce. They fixed my leaking roof quickly and effectively. Very professional. You won’t be disappointed. Thanks guys!

Very responsive friendly local roofer with reasonable turnaround time for our minor roof repairs.  Before and after photos are really useful.  Thank you to Ralph and Pierce for getting this job done.  :-)

I had a very strange situation after some heavy rains recently involving turkey vultures. (They were tugging at and trying to eat the flashing at the top of the chimney of my house as well as multiple neighbors). I was concerned that the area was compromised so I called Ralph and he had a guy come right out and get up there and give me peace of mind. Will definitely be calling them if/when the main roof needs work.

Ralph Brehany and Alex Mejia did an outstanding job.  They delivered a high quality finished product on time, on budget and with no surprises.  Alex and his team are hardworking and very knowledgeable.   The craftsmanship, attention to detail, and service oriented style makes this team superior to other roofing companies. Overall this was an excellent expereince.

Honesty is sometimes a little hard to find in the roofing business and this company is incredibly honest. After having one company tell us that we needed a brand new roof, it was so refreshing to have Ralph’s guys inspect our roof and find nothing that needed to be done. Apex Roofing is always responsive, on time, professional, a great value, and always willing to explain anything in great detail. Highly recommend!

The absolute best company they knew what they were doing and was here and did what needed to be done will definitely use the company again for any roofing need if you need an honest company for your roofing needs please give them a call.

Apex did a great job on the roof. The house is transformed. It really was like a make over. The Team was fast and professional. Ralph is such a nice and friendly person to work with. He really knows the business and couldn't of done a better job. After the job was complete, there wasn't a nail or piece of trash anywhere to be found. I could not of been more pleased with the work, materials used, or the people. Thank you for all of your hard work.
Great service and timeliness

Apex put a new roof on my house recently, and did an extraordinary job. Everything was done exactly how Ralph had promised and committed to doing. The crew, led by Alex, was terrific, and worked extremely hard to make it right. Often times, repair work never measures up to the promises. In this case, Apex exceeded our expectations, and the crew delivered as promised.
I would highly recommend Apex for any roofing needs. They are priced competitively, and their work is impeccable. Ralph is honest and trustworthy, and his crew reflects those same traits.

Ralph and his crew from Apex were an extreme pleasure to work with on our roof replacement.  From quote to completion our expectations were exceeded.  The crew on site was a pleasure to observe and could not do enough to make us comfortable with their work. I cannot think of any concerning issues.  Apex said what they were going to do and did it without flaw.  The house looks great!  I cannot recommend them enough.

From start to finish Ralph Brehany was a refreshing joy to work with.  He gave me an outstanding quote (sans insurance estimate) that was competitive while providing top of the line materials.  His team showed up on time and completed on time in spite of the relentless SC heat.  Every detail was taken care of by the Apex team and the clean up was better than when they started.  A new roof can make a home look 10 years younger and Apex, Ralph and his magical team did just that to our home.  If you need a new roof and want to enjoy the whole experience then call Apex and Ralph Brehany.

Not only did Apex do a great job when they replaced our roof, they also did a great job repairing a whole lot of dry-rotted siding, soffits, etc.

Plus, a couple months after the new roof was installed, a raccoon ripped off a bunch of shingles and underlayment trying to get into our attic.  Apex came and repaired the roofing and didn't charge us!

I’ve never been one to accept reviews at face value, let alone write one. I want readers to trust this review and know that we are real clients of APEX Roofing of the Lowcountry. It’s important that I share my experience with APEX Roofing of the Lowcountry , a company in an industry that is rife with unscrupulous proprietors. Ralph Brehany is the exception to the rule!

My sister, who is disabled, lives alone in Ridgeland. My husband and I live in Florida. A roofing company out of Hilton Head had a replacement roofing job at a home next to my sister. By mistake they removed much of my sister’s roof. Rather than immediately admit their mistake and repair it, they used it as an opportunity to bid a replacement roof at an exorbitant price to a disabled woman on a fixed income. I won’t dwell on the legal issues involved, but when my husband and I found out, we had to do something to make things right.

To make a long story short, we contacted Ralph Brehany at APEX Roofing of the Lowcountry. Ralph empathized with my sister and our dilemma. Even over the phone, his good character came shining through. He took ownership of the situation and put our minds at ease. I know
Ralph prioritized our job (he said there was a cancellation) and completed the roofing in a timely manner. Many issues with rot in the underlayment were encountered and all were repaired or replaced. Knowing that we were not able to check on the progress from Florida, Ralph kept us up to date with emails and photos - both before and after.  We didn’t ask him to do this for us, but it just demonstrates his professionalism.

The new roof includes a full 10 year warranty on workmanship! Just for the record, no money changed hands until the job was completed to our satisfaction and APEX Roofing of the Lowcountry was much less than our previous quote which was only for a roof over (no stripping, no new underlayment and no warranty).

If you are need of a roof, I would strongly encourage you to contact Ralph Brehany at APEX Roofing of the Lowcountry. He runs a moral and upright company with values that are hard to find nowadays.

Thank you Ralph for all of your help and for being a light in the darkness!

Laura & Rick Fender

APEX Roofing, a company with integrity! I highly recommend Ralph, his son and crews! Professionals all around. True to the estimate, timing of job, work ethics of the crew and cleanup throughout the project and after. This is a hard working company and no shananigans on the job site!
Great company to do business with. Professional and courteous. Always there to answer questions and gets the job done right.

I am a single woman living in Sun City and I can’t say enough about the Apex team. From start to finish they were prompt and responded to all of my questions and concerns. The quality of the work is just what I expected when making such a large purchase. The cleanup was way beyond my expectations with multiple walks around my property.   I give them A+ for the number of prompt texts, phone calls and in person conversations we had. My neighbors and I met in the street admiring the finished roof and laughed that we could be so excited about a roof!
Cost and quality couldn’t compare to others. I highly recommend Apex.

I had a roof leak after a prolonged rain right before Christmas and I researched roofing companies.  Apex Roofing had great reviews and I now know why.  Ralph immediately returned my call and said he would have a tech out the day after Christmas.   True to his word, a very courteous and professional tech (Pierce) showed up and explored what was causing my issue.  He took pictures and explained in detail what could be done to repair it.  That night I got a very fair and reasonable quote and when I accepted, they were out two days later to do the repair which was amazing around the holidays.  They took many images showing what section was removed and the replacement underlayment and the finished result.   The next day I spoke with Ralph and he wanted to ensure I was happy with the work and he recapped their guarantee.   I’ve dealt with a lot of contractors on Hilton Head and my experience with Apex Roofing was how I wish all interactions would go.  I can’t recommend this company enough.

Apex Roofing was very  professional in every way. Worked until dark after rain delayed the application. Tarped the roof when steady  rain was expected. Finished in a timely manner and cleaned the property thoroughly. Ralph and crew were very personable and the crew worked steady start to finish.  Ralph was very thorough in detail on how the process will go step by step including warranty and County inspection.  Price was very competitive.
I would definitely recommend Apex Roofing

From start to finish everything was above and beyond EXCELLENT!  My roof had various areas of damage.  I had approximately four companies provide quotes.  Ralph gave me a quote (the price I paid) and did exactly what he said he was going to do from start to finish.

When I called or texted him the phone was answered promptly.  Texts were returned quickly.  Communication was clear, fast and honest.

We are first time homeowners and I was really nervous about certain aspects of the whole process.  I called him multiple (many) times with various questions/concerns.  Ralph was so patient and helpful through all my stress, questions and concerns.  The crew was exceptionally clean following each day’s work.  Work was completed earlier than expected and roof looks great!

I had an area of my roof that needed new flashing.  I am quite certain that Ralph could have easily increased our bill by $500 or more for the labor, supplies and materials.  He showed me the work he did and simply told me “Merry Christmas”.

If you’re roof shopping Apex is the best around.  Look at his reviews!  There’s a reason Apex’s reviews are so great!

Also...Apex’s quote beat all my other quotes (one quote by about $4,000).  Look me up of FB and PM me if you’re skeptical.

We just had a new roof put on our house by Apex, and we are thoroughly satisfied. Ralph sat down with us and explained every detail of the process.  He was very responsive if we had any questions. His crew was wonderful. Very neat and polite. When done, they thoroughly cleaned up the property. Don’t even bother obtaining quotes from other companies. Save time and just hire Apex.

When APEX Roofing of the Low Country comes to your home to do your roof, you’ll be getting so much more than brand new high quality shingles and a 10 year transferrable warranty…you’ll witness first hand why a successful company is a success.  Ralph, the owner of the company, puts people first. He cares about his workers and he cares about his customers.  It is evident that he treats his workers like family and his team of men highly respect him.  He listens to any concerns you may have and doesn’t hesitate to answer any questions about the process. His son, Pierce, is learning from the best and following in his father’s footsteps. His highly skilled team of men share a great camaraderie and set an example of how people in any work force should perform. When a team with their level of skills works harmoniously and takes pride in what they do, the outcome for such a huge undertaking is extraordinary!  I don’t believe we have  to tell you how we feel about our roof.

Respectfully and graciously yours,

Cory and Robert

Thanks again to Apex Roofing for such an amazing job on our new roof that they installed last week. Ralph and his crew are top notch. From the set up to clean up we couldn’t be any more satisfied. If you are considering getting your roof replaced you need to call this 5 star company.

Apex Roofing of the Lowcountry did an absolutely perfect job from start to finish. Ralph Brehaney, (owner), and the crew were so skilled and performed excellently; tearing off old roof and replacing with new Certainteed Shingles in three days, during the hottest days of summer on our 12/12 pitch roof! Simply amazing! The roof/shingles look awesome! Thanks again Apex Roofing for a job well done on every level!! [reviewer's name removed]

We had a leak in two areas in our roof. As a home owner is was very concerned and Apex sent someone in a very timely manner. His son came to fix it -he was very knowledgeable and polite. What more could you want than good work and a family owned business!

A friend referred me to Apex Roofing of the LowCountry.  Ralph Brehany (owner) arrived at my home within an hour to inspect, and ultimately determine, I needed a new roof.
Throughout the process Ralph was knowledgeable, personable, articulate and patient.  He was not pushy in the least.
My roof was replaced by a group of experienced roofers using high quality products.  They arrived on time, worked tirelessly throughout the day, (only breaking for lunch), and had the new roof installed and completed by 1:00pm the next day.  Ralph stopped by multiple times to check on the status of the roof install.
Apex Roofing left our home looking infinitely better than when they started the project.  We also have a (10) yr warranty that protects our home and is transferable should we ever move.
I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Apex Roofing of the LowCountry to anyone.  THANK YOU Ralph, Pierce, Alex and the crew!

Outstanding.
That simply describes my total satisfaction with my decision to have a new roof installed by Apex Roofing. Ralph, the owner, and his roofing team fulfilled and exceeded my expectations - from start to finish. I now have a beautiful leak free roof, warranted for leaks for 10 years, installed by an experienced and professional team of roofers, and Ralph was exceptional in communicating during the entire process.
Ralph and his team are amazing! He is extremely knowledgeable and goes out of their way to make sure his clients are taken care of and happy!

Got several bids from local roofers to replace my roof.  Pricing wise all were similar however Ralph was much more responsive than the other companies and that made the choice easy.  He is a great communicator and understands good service which many companies just don't understand these days.  Fortunately Apex gets it!

I live out of town and needed a roof on my Bluffton home. Through these reviews, I decided to hire Apex Roofing to replace my roof. They did an impeccable job! Ralph, the owner kept me updated on a daily basis with emails and pictures. He was always available when I contacted him by phone. I heard through a friend, who watched the house, that his men were hardworking and the place was left spotless after they were done.
I am very happy with their work and they totally deserve the reviews people have posted.

From my first call to Apex Roofing to the completion of my new roof I couldn't have been more pleased. Both Ralph and Pierce are real gentlemen and it was a pleasure working with them.  They kept me fully appraised of the progress throughout the installation, made the entire experience stress free and our new roof looks awesome.  Thank you Apex!!!

I recently had a re-roof completed by Apex. The quality of the product and workmanship was excellent, far exceeding my expectations. Owner, Ralph,  prepared a detailed bid and spent a good deal of time on the phone with me going over the bid and explaining what would happen next. He met with me to discuss the bid and to explain each step to me. He was beyond patient with me and acknowledged my desire to understand the process.
He was very thorough and respectful. It’s clear he and his son Pierce (the other owner) take great pride in their work and in building good relationships with their clients.  I think it speaks volumes about their dedication that they own a family business together. It was one of the factors that helped me choose them to do the work.  Their workers are very knowledgeable and very respectful and pleasant.
You cannot go wrong choosing Apex.
It will be the best work, product and interaction you can get.

If you’re reading this, you must need a roofer!  We highly recommend this one, Apex Roofing of the Low Country.  The owner takes time to explain exactly what and how they’ll do the job – and then they do exactly that, no surprises.  Communication throughout the project avoided apprehension about what was next, when they’d show up and all the questions you have on a big project like we did – an entire new roof.  They removed the old shingles, underlayment and all the nails and flashing.  Then, replaced all of it with new high-quality materials.  They take care of permits and daily clean-up.  Ask for references and call them, you’ll see his past customers all give the highest marks and highly recommend.

So let me start by saying Ralph is extremely knowledgeable and thorough when it comes to roofing, Pierce is also a fantastic young man with a great head on his shoulders and is very thorough. Apex just installed a new shingle roof for our house that is absolutely amazing. We could not have been happier. Ralph and his guys work hard, and are just absolutely amazing. If you or someone you know is looking for a new roof do yourself a favor Call Ralph and get yourself an amazing roof. Thank you guys.

Apex Roofing of the LowCountry were a pleasure to deal with, they were efficient and competitive.  They explained what was needed in a report & then followed up with pictures & completed work order once the work had been completed.  We would highly recommend them.

You couldn't ask for a better roofing company than Apex! They are true professionals who communicate daily and produce an excellent roof.  Apex was the only roofer (from the three roofers contacted) who pointed out the wind damage on our old roof that our insurance company subsequently covered.  The roof was completed in a day and a half by hard working professional workers and all defects in the old roof were corrected. We can't recommend them highly enough!

Ralph and his crew were exceptional to deal with!  Ralph (owner) is professional, kind, thoughtful and thorough.  He delivered on everything he promised, and with a smile.  And his crew did a no-nonsense job, respectful and neat.  Hats off to a fellow pie lover!!

I had a small, non-emergency repair and Apex Roofing took care of my issue without trying to up sell me on additional services I did not need. I will definitely give them a call for any future roofing needs.
Honest, Affordable and Fast Service. Ralph (owner) responded to my phone call in less than 2 hours and sent his son Pierce the next day to repair a small leak Wow! What a life saver —-Thank You 👍

As a property manager, having reliable contractors is essential.  Ralph and his crew at Apex Roofing are top notch.  They do quality work at a fair price and we can count on them to show up and do the job on time.

We contracted with Apex Roofing to install a standing seam metal roof on the entire roof of our residence.  In May, 2018, Apex removed the old asphalt shingles and then installed the metal roof.  This has to have been one of the best experiences we’ve had in home repair/construction as Ralph, Pierce and their team did a fantastic job in the installation.  They always kept me in the loop on the progress and even sent daily pictures while we were away for a week during the installation. The quality of the metal roof installation is truly top notch.   They are highly recommended!!

We couldn't be more pleased with our experience with Apex roofing. They take great pride in their work and seem to enjoy what they do. Each evening, they cleaned up the work site and sent updated pictures by email. When a problem arose with wet and rotting plywood roof decking and a beam,  they kept us informed about the problem and their solution. They have a great, hard working crew, who are very careful.  Ralph and Pierce were extremely friendly and knowledgeable and we are very satisfied with the new roof.

Excellent from day one thru the entire project.  We had a full roof replacement and Ralph and Pierce were extremely knowledgeable and patient with all of our questions.  Their team were pleasant, respectful and hard workers.  I would recommend APEX roofing to anyone.  Great local company.
Excellent service. The best!! Always takes care of their customer.

I called on a Thursday to fix a leak in my roof that 2 other companies had tried to fix for months and took hours looking for it.  They found it immediately and had it fixed by Saturday for less than I thought it would cost.  It poured that Sunday all day and no leak.  It was 5 star service, communication, and work.
